purpose: Diagnose remaining matrix-column and directional finite-difference failures; do not replace original qualifications

inputs.selection: two largest refined column discrepancies, exposed-data diagnostic
two largest refined column discrepancies, exposed-data diagnostic
two largest refined column discrepancies, exposed-data diagnostic
two largest refined column discrepancies, exposed-data diagnostic

directions: all3 original sin((i+1)*arange(1,m+1)) normalized vectors in all4 cases, plus2 exposed largest-discrepancy coordinate columns
raw_data: positive/negative projected force arrays, actual displacement rounding residuals, central derivative and one-sided derivatives, fixed source geometry
stable_window_rule: Report ALL adjacent-pair max changes below1e-6; a range requires3 consecutive ladder values with both adjacent changes below1e-6. No best-step selection or all-column qualification from selected columns.
repeatability: repeat first-case baseline twice at start and finish; source arrays hashed unchanged
interpretation: small-step worsening, central/one-sided behavior and displacement rounding are diagnostics only; no source attribution to roundoff or spline kinks without additional evidence
review: constructor only; adaptive numerical diagnostic, not physical preregistration
rounding_diagnostic: Project actual (xplus-xminus)/(2h) into tangent coordinates, compare both nominal-Hw and effective-Hqdir errors; retain orthogonal Cartesian direction residual. This uses the exposed approximate H and is diagnostic, not independent validation or a force-error bound.
